map_readings.label: TFL 46 Bugaboo M/L Gate / Access Restriction Location
map_readings.shows: Map title (The Teal-Jones Group), dated October 25, 2021.

map_readings.label: Bugaboo M/L sta. 0+100 Gate or Access Restriction Road Permit R05413
map_readings.shows: Callout box with an arrow pointing to a red Gate Location triangle at the start of the road labelled BUG1000 / BUGABOO M/L where it meets the red mainline, beside the km markers "0" and "36".

map_readings.label: Gate Location
map_readings.shows: Legend: red triangle marks a gate location. Six red triangles appear on the map.

map_readings.label: GORDON RIVER MAIN
map_readings.shows: Red Gate Location triangle on the red mainline between the km markers "32" and "34", where the yellow TFL 46 Boundary line and the road labelled GD5000 meet it. No km label at the triangle.

map_readings.label: GORDON RIVER MAIN
map_readings.shows: Red Gate Location triangle on the red mainline between the km markers "44" and "46", just past where the road labelled LOWER BROWNS M/L branches off. No km label at the triangle.

map_readings.label: BRADEN M/L
map_readings.shows: Red Gate Location triangle on the road labelled BRADEN M/L, beside the km marker "4" near the words "Braden Creek", with an orange pentagon symbol drawn next to it.
Red Gate Location triangle beside the km markers "0" and "44", at the start of a red road leaving the mainline; no road name is printed beside this triangle.

map_readings.label: PANDORA M/L
map_readings.shows: Red Gate Location triangle, partly covered by an orange pentagon, beside a "0" marker at the junction where the roads labelled PANDORA M/L and GRIERSON M/L meet the mainline; a black arrow points to it from a blank white box whose label has been removed. Which road the gate is on is not printed.

map_readings.label: (no legible legend text)
map_readings.shows: Orange pentagon symbols appear in four places (on BUGABOO M/L between km markers "4" and "6", beside a "0" marker near the road labelled GO3100 and km marker "38", at the BRADEN M/L gate and at the PANDORA M/L junction gate). The legend text for this symbol is blanked out, so its meaning cannot be read.

map_readings.label: (blank)
map_readings.shows: Several white boxes cover parts of the map (near the Bugaboo M/L labels, below the GO-3000 label, near GR-12 and at the start of the arrow to the Pandora M/L junction); any labels under them cannot be read.

points.quote: Bugaboo M/L sta. 0+100 Gate or Access Restriction

map_readings.label: Bugaboo M/L sta. 0+100 Gate or Access Restriction Road Permit R05413
map_readings.shows: Callout box with an arrow pointing to a red Gate Location triangle on the red mainline labelled BUGABOO M/L, where it meets the mainline at the circled markers "0" and "36". The labels "BUG1000" and "BUG2000" are printed beside it.

map_readings.label: Bugaboo M/L Gate / Access Restriction Location
map_readings.shows: Map title under "The Teal-Jones Group" and "TFL 46". Legend: red triangle = Gate Location; orange pentagon = legend text blanked out and unreadable; purple asterisk = Point of Interest; green outline = Cutblocks; yellow dashed outline = TFL 46 Boundary; red line = Mainline.

map_readings.label: GORDON RIVER MAIN
map_readings.shows: Red Gate Location triangle on the red mainline between the circled markers "34" and "32", where the yellow TFL 46 Boundary line meets the road, beside the label "GD5000". No km label is printed at the triangle.

map_readings.label: GORDON RIVER MAIN
map_readings.shows: Red Gate Location triangle on the red mainline between the circled markers "44" and "46", just past where the road labelled "LOWER BROWNS M/L" branches off, at the TFL 46 Boundary. No km label is printed at the triangle.

map_readings.label: BRADEN M/L
map_readings.shows: Red Gate Location triangle beside the circled marker "4" on the red mainline labelled "BRADEN M/L", near "Braden Creek", with an orange pentagon just below it. No km label is printed on the triangle itself.

Red Gate Location triangle beside a circled "0" next to the circled "44" on Gordon River Main, at the start of a red mainline running east past the label "BD250" to a circled "2" below the "BRADEN M/L" label. No road name is printed at the triangle. It is listed under BRADEN M/L only because of that run of markers.

map_readings.label: GRIERSON M/L
map_readings.shows: Red Gate Location triangle mostly hidden behind an orange pentagon beside a circled "0", where the mainline labelled "GRIERSON M/L" meets the mainline labelled "PANDORA M/L". A black arrow points to it from a whited-out box. The map does not print which road the gate is on, so no road entry is given for it.

map_readings.label: BUGABOO M/L
map_readings.shows: Orange pentagon (legend text blanked out and unreadable) on the red mainline labelled BUGABOO M/L, just below the circled "4" junction at its west end. A white box covers the map beside it.

map_readings.label: Lonely Doug
map_readings.shows: Orange pentagon (meaning unreadable) beside the circled "0" at the start of the mainline labelled EDINBURGH M/L, near the Lonely Doug point of interest.

map_readings.label: GR-12
map_readings.shows: A whited-out box with a red dashed border near "GR-12" covers an earlier label, and traces of red text show at its edge. Other white boxes also cover parts of the map. Their content cannot be read.
